extraction_notes: Catalytic-test conditions are taken from Section 2.3 and Figure 1 caption: fixed-bed reactor, 0.4 g catalyst, H2/CO2/Ar = 72:24:4, 3.0 MPa, GHSV = 3600 mL/gcat/h. The Cu/ZnX catalysts contain 5 wt% Cu from Section 2.1. Figure 1d stability data contain many closely spaced points over 100 h and were not digitized point-by-point because individual values cannot be read reliably from the provided page image. CO and CH4 selectivities and methanol STY are not reported for the performance entries.
